title: Feelings 4
note: B2 vocab leaf, drafted 2026-09-05 on the home lane. Highest re-teach risk of the B2 vocab leaves so far: five predecessor packs already own 139 emotion words (a1_feelings 17, a2_feelings 15, a2_personality 35, b1_feelings 36, b1_personality 36). Pool swept twice; the first sweep returned overwhelmed, anxious, furious, detached, burnout, mood, temper, comfort and bear all already taught, which is exactly the trap this step exists to catch. What is left, and what this unit is, is the subtler layer: sustained states rather than reactions (grief, resentment, dread), the vocabulary of being under pressure (apprehensive, on edge, insecurity, cope, resilience), and feeling towards other people (empathy, compassion, grudge, betrayed). C57 card 0 recaps Feelings 3. C49 all 36 words across three boards of 12. Build-the-family card bridges adjectives the student already has to the nouns this unit adds: anxious -> anxiety and guilty -> guilt are both recaps of taught words, then resentful -> resentment, insecure -> insecurity, resilient -> resilience inside the unit; all five derived forms are bank items. A12 sense on bitterness (feeling) — the taste reading is the everyday one. Bands 2 B2 / 5 C1 / 29 unbanded, the b2_home profile: emotion vocabulary at this level largely sits outside the Oxford 5k. E10 Use is rewrite production; every underline reconstructs its answer.

cards.title: You already know
cards.note: Feelings 3 gave you strong reactions — upset, delighted, thrilled, amazed, terrified, shocked — and the first feeling-nouns: relief, joy, pride, shame, regret. Those words come back in this unit's sentences. What is new here is quieter and lasts longer: feelings that stay for months, the words for being under pressure, and what you feel towards other people.
cards.note_cz: Feelings 3 ti dal silné reakce — upset, delighted, thrilled, amazed, terrified, shocked — a první podstatná jména pro pocity: relief, joy, pride, shame, regret. Ta slova se vracejí ve větách. Nové je tu něco tiššího, co trvá déle: pocity, které zůstanou měsíce, slova pro život pod tlakem a to, co cítíš vůči druhým lidem.

cards.title: Build the family
points: The first two you already know as adjectives — this unit adds their nouns.
